eyebrow: One clause, on the backup itself
code:
BACKUP LOG MyDatabase
TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\MyDatabase_TailLog.trn'
WITH NORECOVERY;

-- Database now in RESTORING state,
-- same as RESTORE ... WITH NORECOVERY
caption: Captures everything since the last log backup, then takes the database offline.

eyebrow: Required, or not possible at all
The gap if you skip it
code:
-- Last scheduled log backup:  09:00 AM
-- Restore starts (no tail-log): 11:47 AM

-- Everything committed 09:00-11:47
-- is discarded the moment
-- WITH RECOVERY finalizes the restore
caption: SSMS's restore wizard prompts for this automatically — scripted restores don't.
